title: Find the blind spots
text: I am planning to [describe the plan or decision]. List the assumptions I am making, rank them by how much it would hurt if each one is wrong, and tell me which one to test first and how.

title: Argue the other side
text: Here is my plan: [paste]. Act as a skeptical reviewer who wants it to fail. Give me the three strongest objections, then tell me how I would answer each one.

title: Plain language
text: Rewrite this for someone who has never worked in my field, in under 150 words: [paste]. Then list anything important you had to leave out.

title: Turn a mess into next steps
text: Here are my rough notes from a meeting: [paste]. Give me the decisions made, the open questions, and next steps with a suggested owner for each. Ask me about anything missing.

title: Ten minutes to prepare
text: I have ten minutes before I meet [who] about [topic]. Here is the background: [paste]. Give me the five things I need to know and the two questions I should ask.

title: Check my thinking
text: Here is my reasoning: [paste]. Where is it weakest? What evidence would change my mind? Separate what is known from what is guessed.

title: Make it a checklist
text: I do this task often: [describe it]. Turn it into a short checklist with a final check before I send or sign anything.

title: Teach me the basics
text: Teach me the basics of [topic] in five short points, then quiz me with three questions, one at a time, and tell me how I did.
